data.long_meaning: Ishvaku is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ishvakava', which means 'descendant of Surya'. The name Ishvaku carries the meaning “Descendant of Surya” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ishvaku usually hope their child will grow to embody descendant of surya and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: Ishvaku holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism as it is the name of the ancient Solar Dynasty (Suryavaamsa) ruler and the father of renowned King Ikshvaku, who set the foundation for the entire Ikshvaku or Solar Dynasty, from whom several legendary and historical kings emerged. Thus, the name 'Ishvaku' is synonymous with the legacy of powerful and just monarchs, leadership abilities, and the solar lineage in Hindu mythology and history.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the prefix 'Ish' in the name Ishvaku denotes the Hindu God 'Ishvara', meaning 'controller or ruler' of the universe. Therefore, Ishvaku, as a descendant of Surya, carries the responsibility of upholding the divine order and ensuring righteous rule, reflecting the concept of being a god in human form. As a devotional and reverential name, Ishvaku signifies the deep connection between the individual and the universal consciousness, emphasizing the role of spiritual values in governing personal and collective lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ishvaku is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Dwelling Place of Ishva, the Supreme God'. It symbolizes the inner sanctuary where the divine presence resides, reminding us to seek and honor the divine within ourselves and the world.

vedic_reference.note: Not found in Vedas, Upanishads, or other scriptures.

historical_references.reference: Ishvaku is the name of a legendary king in Hindu mythology, who is the father of the divine ruler, Rama. According to the Ramayana, Ishvaku was the son of Sagara, and he is the founder of the Ikshvaku Dynasty.

Another reference to Ishvaku is found in the Mahabharata, where he is listed as one of the great kings of ancient India. According to this epic, Ishvaku ruled over the land of Kosala, and he was known for his righteousness and wisdom.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ishvaku' is gaining modern relevance in various contexts. In Hindu mythology, Ishvaku is an ancient king and the founder of the Solar Dynasty. Today, this name is being explored in modern trends, particularly in the areas of technology, ancestral lineage, and Hindu mythology. One popular platform is mobile apps where users can trace their ancestral lineage back to the legendary king Ishvaku. Another platform is web series that retell the epic tales of Ishvaku and other Hindu legends. Lastly, virtual reality experiences are being created to transport users to the ancient world of Ishvaku, allowing them to immerse themselves in the rich history and culture of this legendary figure.
